name: claujev
description: Jev (TypeSafe AI) as a second pair of eyes for Claude Code: request triage, command guard, rule review, final check, subagent routing and effort suggestion.

api_key.title: TypeSafe AI API key
api_key.description: Your Jev key from typesafe.ai. Stored in the system's secure storage.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Language of the messages Claude receives and of the questions sent to Jev.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe only logs (start here and check the report); enforce lets Jev act on Claude; off disables every hook. A project's .claude/claujev.json can override it per hook.
